name_ar: صياغة استراتيجية الأمن السيبراني واعتمادها من مجلس الإدارة
en: Approved cybersecurity strategy document signed by board or equivalent governing body; board meeting minutes recording approval; strategy version-control log showing review dates
Annual strategy review report; change-log between versions; evidence of trigger-based review (e.g. major incident, regulatory change); sign-off by CISO and executive sponsor

name_ar: إيصال استراتيجية الأمن السيبراني وضمان التوافق التنظيمي
en: Internal strategy briefing records; department-level acknowledgement sign-offs; strategy cascade meeting minutes; alignment evidence from business unit plans referencing cybersecurity objectives

name_ar: تعيين مسؤول الأمن السيبراني وتحديد صلاحياته
en: Formal CISO appointment letter or board resolution; CISO job description with reporting line to C-suite; organisation chart showing position; evidence CISO is independent from IT operations
Committee charter approved by board; meeting minutes for the past 12 months; terms of reference listing members and quorum requirements; action-item tracking register

name_ar: مؤشرات الأمن السيبراني وإعداد التقارير للإدارة العليا
en: Cybersecurity KPI/KRI dashboard reports (at least quarterly); management briefing packs; evidence of escalation path for critical findings; board-level cybersecurity status report
Approved annual cybersecurity budget line in financial plan; budget vs. actual expenditure tracking report; rationale documentation for budget requests; CFO/board approval evidence

name_ar: إعداد إطار سياسات الأمن السيبراني واعتماده
en: Master cybersecurity policy document with approval signatures; policy register listing all tier-2 and tier-3 documents; approval minutes or workflow records; document control metadata (version, owner, next review date)
Policy review schedule showing annual cadence; updated policy versions with change-log; stakeholder consultation records; post-update distribution and acknowledgement evidence
Formal exception request forms with risk justification; approval records from CISO or delegated authority; exception register with expiry dates; compensating controls documentation
Periodic policy compliance assessment reports; automated policy-compliance tool scan results; non-compliance issue log with remediation tracking; internal audit findings relating to policy adherence

name_ar: تحديد مصفوفة الأدوار والمسؤوليات في الأمن السيبراني
en: Published RACI matrix or roles-and-responsibilities document covering all ECC domains; sign-off from department heads; integration with HR job descriptions; organisational chart extract

name_en: Segregation of Duties in Cybersecurity Functions
name_ar: الفصل بين المهام في وظائف الأمن السيبراني
en: SoD matrix for privileged cybersecurity roles; access-control configuration screenshots confirming SoD enforcement; internal audit report on SoD conflicts; compensating controls for identified conflicts

name_ar: المساءلة في الأمن السيبراني على المستوى التنفيذي
en: Executive performance objectives including cybersecurity KPIs; board-approved accountability framework; escalation records for cybersecurity breaches reaching executive level; signed accountability statements

Approved cybersecurity risk management policy/framework document; risk appetite statement endorsed by board; risk methodology document (likelihood/impact scales, scoring criteria); alignment evidence with enterprise risk framework
Current cybersecurity risk register with risk owner, likelihood, impact, inherent/residual risk scores, treatment plans, and review dates; quarterly update records; risk committee review minutes
Risk treatment plan documents with timelines and owners; risk acceptance sign-off records by authorised stakeholders; tracking evidence of treatment milestones; residual risk re-assessment records

name_en: Threat Intelligence Integration into Risk Management
name_ar: دمج معلومات التهديدات في إدارة المخاطر
en: Threat intelligence subscription or feed records; documented process for incorporating threat intel into risk register updates; sample risk-register entries updated based on threat intelligence reports; analyst review logs

name_ar: متطلبات الأمن السيبراني في مرحلة انطلاق المشاريع
en: Project charter templates showing mandatory cybersecurity section; sample completed project charters with cybersecurity requirements; CISO/security team sign-off records on project initiation documents

name_en: Security Review at Key Project Milestones
name_ar: مراجعة الأمن السيبراني عند المراحل الرئيسية للمشاريع
en: Security gate-review checklists for design, development, and pre-go-live phases; sign-off records from security team at each gate; open security findings log with resolution tracking; project closure security sign-off

name_ar: اختبار القبول الأمني قبل تشغيل الأنظمة
en: Security acceptance test plan and results report; VAPT report (if applicable) performed pre-go-live; remediation evidence for critical/high findings; security sign-off letter authorising system go-live

name_ar: سجل الالتزامات التنظيمية والقانونية للأمن السيبراني
en: Maintained regulatory compliance register listing all applicable laws (Cybersecurity Law, PDPL, SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, etc.) with applicability rationale; quarterly update log; legal/compliance team review sign-off

Annual compliance assessment report against each applicable regulation/standard; gap analysis with remediation roadmap; evidence submitted to regulators (e.g. NCA self-assessment submission); third-party audit report

name_ar: الامتثال لمتطلبات الإبلاغ عن الحوادث للجهات التنظيمية
en: Incident notification procedure referencing regulatory timelines (NCA 72-hour rule, SAMA requirements); sample notification records sent to regulators; internal log of incidents assessed for notification obligations

Annual internal audit plan showing cybersecurity scope; completed internal audit reports for the current cycle; finding register with severity ratings and remediation owners; audit committee presentation records

Contract or engagement letter with accredited external assessor; external assessment report (ECC, ISO 27001, or equivalent); management response and remediation plan; evidence of assessor independence

Centralised audit findings register with severity, owner, target date, and status; evidence of remediation (configuration screenshots, policy updates, test results); overdue findings escalation records; closure verification by audit team

Background screening policy referencing cybersecurity roles; completed screening records for employees in security-sensitive roles; third-party screening provider reports; HR and CISO sign-off process evidence

name_ar: التزامات الأمن السيبراني في عقود التوظيف
en: Standard employment contract templates including confidentiality and cybersecurity clauses; signed employee agreements; NDA records for privileged users; legal review confirmation of adequacy

name_ar: إجراءات الأمن السيبراني عند التعيين والنقل والمغادرة
en: HR onboarding/offboarding checklist with cybersecurity steps; access revocation records for leavers (within 24-hour SLA); system access review after role change; IT confirmation of equipment return and account closure

name_en: Disciplinary Process for Cybersecurity Policy Violations
name_ar: الإجراءات التأديبية لمخالفات سياسات الأمن السيبراني
en: Disciplinary policy referencing cybersecurity violations; sample anonymised records of investigations/disciplinary actions; escalation procedure for serious breaches; HR and legal review of disciplinary framework

Annual awareness programme calendar; LMS completion records showing ≥90% staff completion rate; awareness content samples (phishing simulations, e-learning modules, posters); post-training assessment results

name_ar: التدريب التقني على الأمن السيبراني حسب الأدوار
en: Training needs analysis per security role; approved annual training plan; training completion certificates; CPD/certification records (CISSP, CISM, CEH, etc.); budget allocation for training

name_ar: محاكاة التصيد الاحتيالي وتمارين الهندسة الاجتماعية
en: Phishing simulation platform records with click-rate metrics by department; campaign schedule (minimum quarterly); improvement trend analysis over time; targeted remedial training records for repeat clickers

name_ar: إحاطات الأمن السيبراني للقيادة التنفيذية ومجلس الإدارة
en: Board/executive briefing calendar; presentation materials and attendance records; tabletop or scenario exercise evidence involving executives; board acknowledgement of cyber risk appetite

Asset inventory register covering hardware, software, data, and cloud assets with owner, classification, location, and criticality; automated discovery tool scan reports; reconciliation evidence between inventory and actual estate; asset owner acknowledgement records

Asset classification policy defining tiers (e.g. Top Secret, Secret, Confidential, Internal, Public); sample assets labelled in inventory per classification; labelling procedure for physical media; classification review records

Asset lifecycle procedure covering procurement, commissioning, change, and secure disposal; disposal certificates for decommissioned hardware; CMDB or asset database change logs; audit of inventory accuracy vs. physical count

name_ar: سياسة التحكم في الوصول وعملية تزويده
en: Approved access control policy; formal access request workflow records (ticket system screenshots); approval chain records showing business owner and security team sign-off; SLA compliance metrics for access provisioning

PAM solution deployment evidence; list of privileged accounts with justification for each; privileged access usage logs reviewed by security; CyberArk/BeyondTrust or equivalent tool configuration reports; quarterly privileged account review records

MFA enforcement policy; technical configuration evidence showing MFA enabled for remote access, privileged accounts, and cloud services; authentication logs confirming MFA challenge events; exception register with compensating controls

Quarterly user access review records signed off by business owners; access certification reports from IAM system; evidence of access revocation following review; over-privileged account remediation records

Password policy document (minimum length, complexity, rotation, lockout thresholds); technical configuration evidence from AD/LDAP/IAM confirming policy enforcement; sample lockout-event logs; password manager deployment evidence

Approved hardening baselines per OS/platform (CIS Benchmarks or equivalent); automated compliance scan results (e.g. CIS-CAT, Tenable) showing baseline adherence %; deviation register with compensating controls; baseline review schedule

Patch management policy with SLAs by severity (Critical ≤72h, High ≤30 days); vulnerability scan reports showing patch compliance rate; change records for patches applied; overdue patch register with risk acceptance

name_ar: حماية نقاط النهاية (مضاد الفيروسات / الكشف والاستجابة)
en: EDR/AV solution deployment coverage report (target ≥98% managed endpoints); signature/definition update frequency logs; detection and response event summary; EDR policy configuration screenshots; excluded-endpoint risk-acceptance records
Secure SDLC policy; SAST/DAST tool scan results integrated into CI/CD pipeline; developer secure-coding training records; code review checklist with security checks; sample secure code-review records

name_ar: بوابة أمان البريد الإلكتروني وضوابط مكافحة البريد المزعج
en: Email security gateway configuration report; blocked/quarantined message statistics (monthly); anti-spam rule-set review records; email filtering coverage confirmation for all inbound/outbound paths

name_ar: مصادقة البريد الإلكتروني (SPF و DKIM و DMARC)
en: DNS records confirming SPF, DKIM, DMARC configuration; DMARC aggregate (rua) reports; DMARC policy set to at least 'quarantine'; periodic DNS health-check records; spoofing attempt logs

name_ar: الحماية المتقدمة من التصيد الاحتيالي وعزل الملفات المشبوهة
en: Sandboxing solution deployment evidence; detection rate metrics for phishing and malicious attachments; URL rewriting/detonation configuration records; threat-intelligence feed integration evidence; incident records of phishing attacks detected

Network architecture diagram showing security zones (DMZ, internal, OT, management); firewall rule-set review evidencing zone separation; inter-zone traffic flow approval records; periodic segmentation validation test reports

name_ar: إدارة جدران الحماية من الجيل التالي
en: Firewall policy/rule-set review records (semi-annual minimum); rule cleanup evidence (removal of orphaned/overly permissive rules); change management records for firewall rule changes; NGFW configuration baseline report
IDS/IPS deployment architecture evidence; tuning records showing false-positive reduction; alert and block event summaries; integration evidence with SIEM; signature update frequency logs

Remote access solution configuration documentation; MFA enforcement evidence for VPN/remote sessions; split-tunnelling policy and justification; user remote access logs reviewed for anomalies; zero-trust access policy if applicable

Wireless security policy; Wi-Fi configuration evidence (WPA3 or WPA2-Enterprise, SSID isolation); rogue AP detection scan records; guest network isolation confirmation; wireless penetration test results
MDM/UEM solution enrolment report showing managed device coverage; device compliance policy configuration screenshots; non-compliant device blocking evidence; remote-wipe capability test records
BYOD policy document; BYOD enrolment agreement signed by users; containerisation or MAM configuration evidence separating corporate and personal data; periodic BYOD device compliance audit records

name_ar: الحماية من التهديدات على الأجهزة المحمولة والتحكم في التطبيقات
en: Approved application whitelist/blacklist records; mobile threat defence solution deployment evidence; jailbroken/rooted device detection and blocking logs; OS patching compliance report for mobile estate

Data classification policy with defined sensitivity tiers; data handling guidelines per classification; data labelling tooling configuration evidence; sample labelled documents/datasets; staff acknowledgement of handling procedures
DLP solution deployment scope (endpoint, network, cloud); DLP policy rule-set review; incident/alert log showing DLP events investigated; false-positive tuning records; DLP coverage gap analysis

Data retention schedule aligned to legal/regulatory requirements; secure deletion and overwrite procedure; destruction certificates for physical media and hardware; periodic data purge records with authorisation sign-off

name_ar: حماية البيانات الشخصية (التوافق مع نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية)
en: PDPL compliance assessment report; data processing activities register (Article 18 PDPL); privacy impact assessments for high-risk processing; evidence of data subject rights process; DPO appointment record

Approved cryptography policy specifying approved algorithms and key lengths (AES-256, RSA-2048+, TLS 1.2+ minimum); key management procedure covering generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and destruction; HSM deployment evidence; key custodian appointment records

TLS configuration scan results (e.g. SSL Labs A-grade); evidence of TLS 1.2+ enforced on all externally-facing services; internal service-to-service encryption configuration records; VPN encryption algorithm documentation

Encryption-at-rest configuration evidence for databases, file stores, and backups; BitLocker/FileVault/OS-level encryption reports for endpoints; cloud storage encryption settings; encryption key rotation records

Approved backup policy specifying RPO/RTO per system tier; backup schedule configuration evidence; backup job success/failure logs (minimum 30-day history); offsite/cloud backup confirmation; backup encryption evidence

name_ar: اختبار سلامة النسخ الاحتياطية والتحقق من استعادتها
en: Quarterly restore test records with results and sign-off; backup verification tool reports confirming data integrity; documented test scenarios matching actual recovery needs; issues identified during testing and remediation records

name_ar: عزل النسخ الاحتياطية وعدم قابليتها للتغيير
en: Evidence of backup network/storage segregation from production; immutable/WORM storage configuration for critical backups; ransomware protection capability for backup solution; access control records limiting production admin access to backups

Vulnerability scanning policy with scan frequency (critical assets weekly, others monthly minimum); scan tool configuration and coverage reports; authenticated vs unauthenticated scan evidence; asset coverage percentage metric

name_ar: تحديد أولويات الثغرات ومستويات الخدمة لمعالجتها
en: Vulnerability remediation SLA matrix by CVSS severity; current open vulnerability report with age tracking; remediation trend metrics showing reduction over time; risk acceptance records for vulnerabilities not remediated within SLA

name_ar: معلومات الثغرات والاستجابة للثغرات غير المعروفة
en: Threat intelligence feed subscription records; zero-day response procedure with emergency patching process; records of emergency patch deployments; NCA/CERT-SA vulnerability alert response logs

Scope and rules of engagement document; penetration test report from accredited provider; management response with remediation plan; re-test report confirming critical/high findings remediated; CISO sign-off on final report

Internal penetration test scope document; test report with findings; evidence of remediation for critical/high severity findings; re-test confirmation; comparison with previous year's findings showing improvement

Red team engagement scope and objectives document; red team exercise report (findings, attack paths, detection gaps); blue team/SOC response evaluation; lessons-learned record; executive briefing on outcomes

SIEM deployment architecture document; log source coverage report (% of critical assets onboarded); correlation rule-set and tuning records; alert triage metrics (MTTD, MTTR); SIEM capacity and retention configuration

Log collection policy specifying mandatory log sources and minimum 12-month retention; storage sizing evidence; log integrity controls (e.g. write-once, hash verification); sample log completeness verification records
SOC operational model document (in-house or MSSP); 24×7 monitoring coverage evidence; SLA for alert response times; SOC analyst shift records; escalation procedure and evidence of it being followed
UEBA tool deployment evidence; baseline behaviour model configuration; anomaly detection alert records; insider threat detection case records; UEBA integration with SIEM/SOAR

Approved incident response plan covering detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review; role-specific playbooks (ransomware, DDoS, data breach, insider threat); annual plan review records; distribution evidence to response team

Incident classification matrix (P1–P4 or equivalent) with escalation thresholds; sample incident tickets with classification field populated; average classification time metrics; misclassification review records
Annual tabletop exercise agenda and participant list; exercise scenario and injects document; after-action report with lessons learned; improvement actions register with completion evidence

name_ar: مراجعة ما بعد الحادثة والتحسين المستمر
en: Post-incident review reports for all P1/P2 incidents; root cause analysis documentation; corrective action register with owners and due dates; evidence of corrective actions completed; CISO sign-off on closure

Threat intelligence platform or feed subscription records; threat intel analyst role definition; sample threat intelligence reports produced/consumed; integration with SIEM/SOAR for automated indicator ingestion; ISAC membership records (e.g. FS-ISAC)

name_en: Physical Access Controls for Critical Facilities
en: Data centre and server room access control system configuration (badge readers, biometrics); access list showing authorised individuals and justification; access log reports reviewed monthly; unauthorised access alarm records

CCTV coverage map for critical facilities; recording retention configuration (minimum 90 days); periodic CCTV footage review records; alarm response procedure and test records; security guard post orders

name_ar: ضوابط البيئة المادية في مراكز البيانات
en: Data centre environmental monitoring system configuration (temperature, humidity, fire suppression, flood sensors); alert threshold configuration; maintenance records for UPS, HVAC, and fire systems; environmental incident log

WAF deployment evidence for all public-facing web applications; WAF rule-set review and tuning records; blocked attack event statistics; false-positive reduction records; WAF in enforcement (not detection-only) mode confirmation

name_ar: تقييم الثغرات وفق قائمة OWASP العشرة الأولى
en: DAST scan results against OWASP Top 10 for all web applications; manual assessment report (where automated tools insufficient); remediation records for critical/high findings; developer OWASP training completion records

API inventory register; API gateway configuration evidence (authentication, rate limiting, input validation); API security scan results; OAuth 2.0 / JWT implementation review; API change management records

name_ar: تحليل الأثر على الأعمال المتعلق بالأمن السيبراني
en: BIA document with cyber threat scenarios incorporated; cyber-specific impact criteria (data loss, service outage, reputational harm); RTO/RPO defined per critical system from cyber perspective; BIA review records (annual minimum)

name_ar: خطة استمرارية الأعمال لحوادث الأمن السيبراني
en: BCP/DRP with dedicated cyber incident annex or cyber-scenario procedures; manual workaround procedures for critical systems during cyber outage; cross-reference between incident response plan and BCP; BCP owner and version-control records

Cyber resilience exercise schedule; tabletop exercise records with cyber disruption scenarios (ransomware, DDoS, data centre loss); full BCP/DR test records; lessons-learned register; improvement actions with completion evidence

name_en: Crisis Communication Plan for Cyber Incidents
name_ar: خطة التواصل في أزمات الأمن السيبراني
en: Crisis communication plan document with pre-approved messaging templates; stakeholder communication matrix (staff, customers, regulators, media); communication exercise records; spokesperson designation and training evidence

name_ar: تقييم مخاطر الأمن السيبراني للأطراف الثالثة
en: Third-party risk assessment methodology document; completed risk assessment records for all critical suppliers; risk-tiering matrix (critical/high/medium/low); assessment review cycle records; assessments triggered by supplier changes

name_ar: متطلبات الأمن السيبراني في عقود الأطراف الثالثة
en: Standard contract clause library for cybersecurity requirements; sample executed contracts showing cybersecurity obligations; right-to-audit clauses evidence; incident notification obligation in contracts; legal review confirmation of clause adequacy

name_ar: الرصد المستمر لالأمن السيبراني للأطراف الثالثة
en: Third-party monitoring schedule and methodology; annual security questionnaire responses and review records; third-party audit or assessment reports; corrective action records for non-compliant suppliers; supplier termination process for persistent non-compliance

Just-in-time access provisioning records for third-party sessions; third-party access review records (at least quarterly); VPN/jump server configuration for third-party remote access; session recording evidence for privileged third-party access

name_ar: تقييم مخاطر الأمن السيبراني للخدمات السحابية واعتمادها
en: Cloud adoption risk assessment methodology; completed risk assessments for all cloud services in use; CISO and data protection officer approval records for cloud deployments; NCA cloud guidelines compliance evidence; data residency confirmation for sensitive data

name_ar: تطبيق نموذج المسؤولية المشتركة في السحابة
en: Shared responsibility matrix for each cloud service (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS); documented customer-side security controls per cloud provider; gap analysis between CSP baseline and organisational requirements; cloud security architecture diagram

name_ar: إدارة تكوين الأمن السيبراني في السحابة ووضعه
en: CSPM tool deployment evidence; cloud security benchmark compliance score (CIS Cloud Benchmarks); misconfiguration alert records and remediation tracking; multi-account/multi-cloud coverage report; cloud resource inventory completeness

Cloud storage encryption configuration evidence (customer-managed keys preferred); data classification applied to cloud-stored data; DLP policies active on cloud platforms; data exfiltration monitoring records; cloud backup encryption evidence

name_en: Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) / Shadow IT Controls
name_ar: وسيط أمان الوصول للسحابة والتحكم في تقنية المعلومات غير المعتمدة
en: CASB solution deployment evidence; unsanctioned cloud app discovery report (shadow IT); cloud app risk assessment and approval/block records; cloud usage policy and enforcement evidence; CASB integration with identity provider

name_ar: جرد أصول أنظمة التحكم الصناعية وتصنيفها
en: Dedicated ICS/OT asset inventory separate from IT inventory; asset classification by criticality and safety impact; passive asset discovery tool results (e.g. Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi); asset owner assignment records; vendor/model/firmware version tracking

name_ar: الفصل الشبكي بين بيئات تقنية المعلومات والتقنيات التشغيلية
en: Network architecture diagram confirming IT/OT segmentation (air gap or industrial DMZ); firewall rule-set between IT and OT zones; unidirectional gateway (data diode) deployment evidence where required; inter-zone traffic monitoring records

name_ar: إدارة الثغرات والتصحيحات الخاصة بأنظمة التحكم الصناعية
en: ICS vulnerability scanning results using passive/safe scanning tools; ICS-specific CVE tracking (ICS-CERT advisories); vendor-coordinated patching records with change control; unpatched ICS system compensating controls documentation; maintenance window scheduling records

name_ar: خطة الاستجابة للحوادث في أنظمة التحكم الصناعية
en: ICS-specific incident response plan or annex to the main IRP; OT/ICS incident classification criteria; ICS response team roster with OT vendor contacts; integration between ICS IRP and plant emergency response plan; ICS incident response exercise records

name_ar: أمن الوصول عن بُعد لأنظمة التحكم الصناعية
en: ICS remote access policy restricting access to pre-approved IP ranges and personnel; MFA enforcement for all ICS remote access; vendor remote access session monitoring and recording; time-limited access token records; emergency remote access procedure
